workload_method: Gold trees including ROOT and Finish. Count exact oracle actions from Proposition 4. Multiply by training inventory size for scalar scores and by the sum of affine weight matrix sizes for MACs.
structure_method: Sentence-level multiset matches on saved trees with punctuation retained, excluding preterminals and outer ROOT. Arity matches label, terminal span and exact number of children before grouping. Length strata use label and span and bin whole sentences by number of tokens.
